Manages a collection of stats and buffs, providing methods to update, add, and remove stats and buffs.

Remarks

Stats coordinates the application of all active buffs to all registered stats. Stat values are recalculated during Update(float), and buff-related events are raised when buffs are added, removed, or stacked.
